item: Every thread src/ starts carries a name, pinned by an AST scan
summary: tests/test_threads_are_named.py scans src/ for threading.Thread / Timer constructors with no name (a name= argument, or a later .name assignment in the same function, which is how columnar.serve_canary names its Timer: read from the code, not listed); it was red on exactly three (data_volume.py:393, shutdown.py:70, uninstall.py:296), now named oo-drive-page, oo-shutdown and oo-uninstall. open_stats.thread_family files them under their own oo-drive / oo-shutdown / oo-uninstall instead of (other); none of the three opens the store (shutdown and uninstall only dispose the engine), so no open count moves. Not covered: a Thread subclass (none in src/, pinned), pool workers (two ThreadPoolExecutor sites pass no thread_name_prefix and read as ThreadPoolExecutor-N, a family thread_family knows: src/llm/concurrency.py:110 and src/ingest/segmented_download.py:89, left to their owners as one-liners and pinned as exactly those two; src/scheduler/runner.py already passes oo-collect), and the standard library's own threads (ThreadingHTTPServer request threads on the pre-boot drive page, ProcessPoolExecutor's manager thread in reindex_parallel.py).
